headline: Ross Smith beats Price 11-5 to win the World Series of Darts Finals
standfirst: Ross Smith won the World Series Finals in Amsterdam with a 103.89 average in the final and a tournament-high 29 maximums.
body: Ross Smith won the World Series of Darts Finals at AFAS Live in Amsterdam, beating Gerwyn Price 11-5 in the final. Smith averaged 103.89 to Price's 97.28.
Smith beat Kevin Doets 6-3 with a 102.98 average, then Daryl Gurney 10-5 and Josh Rock 10-7. He was below his best in the semi-finals but still beat Gian van Veen 11-8.

Price had been the player in form before the final. He averaged 103.86 to beat James Wade 10-7, including a 170 checkout, and 104.07 in an 11-7 semi-final win over Jonny Clayton. That was the highest average of the tournament.
Clayton beat Luke Littler 10-4 in the quarter-finals. Gurney also hit a 170 checkout, against Michael van Gerwen in the last 32.
Smith hit 29 of the event's 242 maximums. Price hit 25 and Dirk van Duijvenbode 22.
